name: kraft
description: Kraft, a local orchestrator that takes your coding agent from spec to merge request, stopping only when a decision is yours; and Kraft Lite, its chains without the orchestrator.

plugins.name: kraft
plugins.description: Drive Kraft from an agent session: file work, read the board, act on gates, recover stopped work.

plugins.name: kraft-lite
plugins.description: Walk a Kraft chain from spec to merge request inside your coding-agent session. It stops for your approval at each decision and limits its repair attempts. No server to run.
